executive_summary: All 6 runtime claims from Forensic Reviewer (Phase 10 TRUE) are CONFIRMED BROKEN. The NRAM v5 feature set is non-functional at the runtime level. Features exist as code but are never wired into the execution path. The system appears to work because broken features have zero overhead and produce no errors.

claim_verdicts.root_cause: Conceptors never loaded, no artifact files exist
DExpertsController never instantiated in runtime path

claim_verdicts.impact: Feature produces placeholder output, not real model generation

claim_verdicts.claim: Request isolation works with batched execution
claim_verdicts.root_cause: Thread-local storage unsafe for async execution
claim_verdicts.impact: Cross-request contamination and race conditions in async batching

test_evidence.details: Task 0 saw task 3's context, tasks 1-3 got null

claim_verdicts.root_cause: Decorative parameter with no runtime enforcement
claim_verdicts.impact: coherence_floor has no effect on generation

risk_assessment.user_impact: All NRAM v5 features are non-functional. Users requesting activation addition, conceptor steering, DExperts, or branch-and-tournament will receive no intervention. Request isolation is broken for async batching. coherence_floor parameter is ignored.
risk_assessment.data_integrity_risk: LOW - features fail silently with zero overhead
risk_assessment.security_risk: MEDIUM - request isolation broken, potential cross-contamination

immediate_actions: Add startup code to load activation vectors and conceptors from artifacts
Wire BranchAndTournamentGenerator to real SGLang engine generation
Replace thread-local with async-safe context (e.g., contextvars)
Implement coherence measurement and enforcement in logit processor
testing_recommendations: Add integration tests that verify vector loading at startup
Add concurrency tests for async request isolation
Add end-to-end tests that verify intervention telemetry events
Add tests that verify branch tournament produces real model output
documentation_recommendations: Update feature documentation to reflect actual runtime status
Add known limitations section for non-functional features

next_phase.reason: Cannot pass release gate with 6 critical defects. All defects must be remediated and re-verified.
next_phase.estimated_remediation_effort: 2-3 days for full remediation and re-testing
